$comment: Shared feasibility engine fixtures. Every case is input -> expected output of calculate() (edits null) or recalculate(inputs, edits). The TypeScript engine (packages/feasibility-engine) and the Python engine (backend/core/engine) must reproduce `expected` exactly (deep equality, no tolerance). Engineering fixtures derived from the client's formulas: replace or extend with the client's worked examples and set client_validated to true once the client confirms the numbers. Never regenerate from an engine.

rounding.rule: round half away from zero on the shortest decimal representation of the double; applied to outputs and to the displayed assumption bounds only, never to intermediate values; -0 is normalised to 0

cases.name: up12_centar_rates
cases.description: Sample parcel UP 12 with the Centar admin rates: per-m² inputs, multiplier bounds 0.86 / 1.15, default saleable share.

cases.name: client_style_absolute_inputs
cases.description: Worked-example style: cadastral basis 1000 m², absolute cost totals and absolute price bounds.

cases.name: far_not_stated
cases.description: FAR missing: GFA cannot be calculated and everything derived from it follows; the coverage area and the land value still can.

cases.name: coverage_not_stated
cases.description: Site coverage missing: only the coverage area is affected.

cases.name: no_market_data
cases.description: No market row for the zone: the money figures cannot be calculated; the three areas still can.

cases.name: no_market_zone_unknown
cases.description: No market row and no zone: the default market reason.

cases.name: user_edits_over_multiplier_bounds
cases.description: User edits saleable share 0.80, construction 700 €/m² and selling price 2600 €/m² over the Centar rates: the multiplier bounds follow the edited values.

cases.name: user_edits_over_absolute_bounds
cases.description: User edits the selling price to 2500 over absolute bounds 2000 / 2500 at expected 2200: the bounds scale proportionally (2272.73 / 2840.91); a construction edit replaces the total with a per-m² rate carrying no spread.

cases.name: edits_do_not_rescue_missing_market
cases.description: Without a market row, user edits of construction cost and price do not make the money figures computable (the land and design rates are unknown).

cases.name: area_unknown
cases.description: No plot area: every figure is unknown.

cases.name: zero_area_total_cost_zero
cases.description: A stated area of 0 with per-m² costs: every cost is 0, so ROI cannot be calculated (division by zero) while the other figures are 0.

cases.name: far_missing_takes_precedence_over_missing_market
cases.description: FAR and market both missing: the GFA-derived money figures report requires_gfa; the land value, which needs no FAR, reports the market reason.

cases.name: negative_profit
cases.description: A low selling price against the Centar costs: profit and ROI are negative and the range stays ordered.

cases.name: stated_zero_far
cases.description: A stated FAR of 0 is a real 0, not a missing value: GFA and its dependents are 0 and ROI is −100 % (only the land value is a cost).
